Alibaba is trying to make a giant AI model cheaper to actually use. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next has 125 billion parameters, but it activates only 6 billion at a time. Instead of calling on the whole model for every answer, it brings a much smaller portion to work. That matters if you want AI running on your own hardware. Unsloth says a compressed build fits in 75 gigabytes of regular RAM without using graphics-card memory. That is still a serious machine, but it is much closer to a local AI box than a data center. Alibaba also plans a cloud version starting at sixteen cents per million input tokens. Would you buy the hardware or keep paying by the token? #Qwen #LocalAI #OpenWeights #ArtificialIntelligence
